## Description

An `EDGE_CURVE` references a `LINE` whose two declared bounding parameters yield identical 3D points. The "edge" has zero length even though the curve is non-degenerate by type. Bug-reporter language: "zero-length edge", "line edge collapses to a point", "degenerate line edge".

## Reproducer recipe

`EDGE_CURVE` whose `edge_start` and `edge_end` both reference `#V` at (0,0,0); `edge_geometry` is a `LINE` from (0,0,0) along direction (1,0,0); both edge parameters declared as `0.0`.

Promote the edge to degenerate, drop it from incident wires, or reject.
